sentences.en: What he meant by those words finally dawned on me.
sentences.zh: 他话里的意思终于让我明白了。

sentences.en: The crowing of a cock is the harbinger of dawn.
sentences.zh: 公鸡打鸣是黎明的预兆。

sentences.en: It has dawned on me that I mistook his intention.
sentences.zh: 我意识到自己误解了他的意图。

senses.zh: 拂晓，破晓，黎明；开端；曙光
破晓；开始；见分晓，水落石出
